epic.title: EPIC-002: Configuration de Rapport (Wizard 4 étapes)
epic.description: L'éditeur peut configurer un rapport complet via le wizard : marque (Brandfetch), pays avec langue auto-détectée, catégories IA, questions (perception/visibility/competitive), sélection des LLMs. Sauvegarde atomique avec validation de quotas.

userStory.want: a 4-step wizard layout with navigation controls
userStory.so_that: I can progress through report configuration in a structured flow

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: 4-step stepper with navigation via Next/Back buttons, sticky header with progress bar, sticky footer with CTA
Discard Changes modal (462x222px) when navigating back with unsaved changes

technicalDetails.stateManagement: Wizard state in Zustand (local, no URL deep-linking)

userStory.want: to search and select a brand with auto-complete suggestions
userStory.so_that: I can identify my brand with its logo and domain

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Auto-complete suggestions with logo and domain from Brandfetch (debounce 300ms), Custom Brand option available
Brand input shows red border error when submitting without selection

userStory.want: to add countries with auto-detected language and designate a primary market
userStory.so_that: I can define the geographic scope of my analysis

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Auto-detect language (France→French), override via edit icon, first country auto-marked as Primary when second added
Error shown on duplicate country+language combinations
Button disabled with warning banner at country quota limit

migrations: markets table: reportId, country, language, code, isPrimary
quotas table: moved here to avoid forward dependency

userStory.want: AI to detect relevant categories for my brand across my selected countries
userStory.so_that: I don't have to manually research what categories apply

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Intermediate 'Discovering Categories' screen with progress bar and 15-20 second note
Each category shows 'AI GENERATED' badge, categories in primary market language
Add custom categories with auto-translation, showing 'CUSTOM' badge
Remove categories with confirmation modal, Last One Rule respected (delete icon hidden if only 1)

frontend: CategoryAccordion component with expand/collapse for translations

database.migrations: categories table: reportId, name, origin, translations JSON

userStory.want: to review and customize the auto-generated questions for each category and market
userStory.so_that: the analysis asks exactly what matters to my brand

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Loading state 'Generating questions...' with spinner
Market tabs (flag + country + language abbr), 3 sub-tabs: Sentiment | Visibility | Competitive, grouped by category with counter
Edit inline (Enter save, Escape cancel) or delete with 5s undo toast
Auto-append '?' to questions
Reject empty questions, restore last saved version
Invalid characters show error state (59px height)
Quota limit blocking toast for + Add Question
Competitive Analysis shows info banner and [Competitor 1-5] placeholders in grey

technicalDetails.questionManagement: Default frontend templates per question type, user customizes in Step 3, stored in Zustand until submission

database.migrations: questions table: reportId, marketId, categoryId, questionText, questionType

userStory.want: to review a summary of my configuration and select AI engines before submitting
userStory.so_that: I can verify everything is correct before the analysis runs

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Display 'Ready to analyze {Brand}' with 3 summary cards: Countries, Categories, Total Questions
LLM cards show logo, name, description, Web search checkbox, ON/OFF toggle (default: Gemini ON, ChatGPT ON)
Smart-Select: auto-reactivate all LLMs if all are OFF
Atomic save with double quota validation, returns 201 Created
Return 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED if concurrent overcommit detected
First-time config redirects to report page
Subsequent edits save immediately, results at next scheduled execution

technicalDetails.validation: Double validation: quota check at start AND end
frontend: LlmToggleCard component with Web search checkbox

userStory.want: the system to validate quotas at each step and show clear warnings
userStory.so_that: I don't exceed my organization's limits

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: At quota limit: disable '+' button, show yellow warning banner
brand_markets quota message: 'You have reached the maximum...'
Backend validation: brand_markets_used+new <= max_brand_markets, categories <= max, questions/type <= max, LLMs <= max

technicalDetails.frontend: Warning banners per limit type with used/max counts
technicalDetails.backend: QuotaValidator in geo-config-manager with double validation pattern

stories.title: Configuration de Rapport (Wizard 4 étapes) — Tests manuels
stories.description: Comprehensive manual testing of the entire 4-step wizard configuration flow

useCases.name: Complete Wizard Navigation (4 steps)
useCases.description: Verify stepper reflects current step, Next/Back buttons work, Discard Changes modal appears if unsaved changes exist

useCases.name: Brandfetch Brand Search & Selection
useCases.description: Verify suggestions display with logo+domain, Custom Brand option available, error on empty brand

useCases.name: Market Configuration (Country + Language)
useCases.description: Verify auto-detected language, modification via edit icon, Primary market auto-marking, duplicate detection, quota limits

useCases.name: AI Category Discovery (Step 2)
useCases.description: Verify loading screen, AI GENERATED badges, custom categories, deletion with Last One Rule

useCases.name: Prompts Review (Step 3)
useCases.description: Verify inline editing, deletion with undo, auto-append '?', empty rejection, invalid character handling, quota limits

useCases.name: Review & Submit (Step 4)
useCases.description: Verify summary cards, LLM toggles with defaults, Smart-Select, atomic save, redirection

useCases.name: Quota Validation & Warnings
useCases.description: Verify warning banners at limits, blocked actions, clear used/max indicators
